subject: Competitor Watch updated: basket rule enabled
body:
The monitoring rule has been updated as requested.

Pre-order stores and products are excluded. After dismissing any delay/status notices, a simple item successfully appearing in the basket means OPEN for deliveries in these alerts. Items requiring extra choices are skipped.

Checks remain every five minutes during the current trial, 09:00–23:30 Gibraltar time. Delay/closure updates continue on each successful check; recovery needs two agreeing checks and is announced once.

This is a setup confirmation, not a new observation of Hungry Monkey’s current status. The next status alert will be based on the live basket check. No order is placed by the monitor.
